Name: Iridium Milk Cow
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Iridium Cow adds a new late-game barn animal with its own progression path, custom milk, permanent health reward, and two selectable visual styles.[/font]
[spoiler][font=Comic Sans MS]After experiencing Mr. Qi's level-100 Skull Cavern milk event, you can buy an Iridium Livestock Permit in the Walnut Room for 100 Qi Gems. Bring the permit to Marnie, then wait until the next morning for her letter and the Iridium Cow to become available in her livestock shop.[/font][/spoiler]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Iridium Milk permanently adds 25 maximum health and 25 current health each time it is consumed. Health is unrestricted. To keep very large health totals from making the HUD bar grow endlessly, the health bar grows normally through the vanilla permanent-health range and then stays at the 205-health visual size while continuing to show your real current/max health proportion.

The default animal art is the Vanilla-style Iridium Cow. An optional Facelift style is also included, based on/derived from siamece's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] assets and used under that mod's Nexus asset-use permissions with credit. [/font]
